residue_2_in_census_no_card_names.note: Census parts that NO wave-1 card names. ⛔ THIS IS THE HALF THE RECONCILE EXISTS FOR: a store no card mentions is exactly what Andrew called concerning, and it is structurally invisible to any manifest assembled FROM the cards. Phase A being an INDEPENDENT instrument is the only reason this list is non-empty.

out_of_domain_note: Entries a card legitimately names that are NOT persisted graph objects (the live AWS estate, the repo source tree, tool ledgers, the process-generated C7 population). Counting these as 'missing from the census' would INFLATE residue 1 with things that were never in the declared domain. They are dispositioned separately and on purpose.
unresolved_note: UNRESOLVED is a CONFORMING value per 2.0.0_SA_COO~X 73421. Card entries are prose; where a string cannot be tied to one object without inference, it stays UNRESOLVED rather than being forced onto a part. A forced match is worse than an honest UNRESOLVED because it silently merges two objects.
no_summing: ⛔ I do NOT adopt 51, 43, 39, 37 or 35 as a part count, per 73421. The card-side entry count (42) and the census part count (39) are DIFFERENT POPULATIONS over DIFFERENT GRAINS and are not commensurable. One card entry can name TWO objects (measured: 3 such entries here), and many entries name the same object across cards.
